section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION - Front Suspension
title: Strut Bar
ocr_text:
Strut Bar
(See page FA-14)

REMOVAL OF STRUT BAR

1. REMOVE STRUT BAR FROM BRACKET
Remove the nut and strut bar from the bracket.
NOTE: Do not remove the staked nut.

2. REMOVE STRUT BAR FROM LOWER ARM
Jack up the lower arm and disconnect the strut bar.
Remove the bolt holding the strut bar to the lower arm
and disconnect the strut bar.

INSTALLATION OF STRUT BAR

1. ADJUST STAKED NUT
Check that the distance between the staked nut and center
of the bolt hole is 369.1 mm (14.531 in.). Adjust staked
nut as necessary.
NOTE: Do not move staked nut unless required.

369.1 mm

2. CONNECT STRUT BAR TO LOWER ARM
Connect the strut bar to the lower arm with a bolt. Torque
the bolt.
Torque: 670 kg·cm (48 ft·lb, 66 N·m)

3. CONNECT STRUT BAR TO BRACKET
Connect the strut bar to the bracket with a nut. Torque
the nut.
Torque: 1,050 kg·cm (76 ft·lb, 103 N·m)

4. CHECK FRONT WHEEL ALIGNMENT AND SIDE SLIP
(See page FA-3)
